source_policy: curated original examples authored for LANTRA; no external dataset copied
notes: All variants from the same source group stay in one split to reduce template/source leakage.
Every task has train, validation, and test coverage above the trainer default minimum sample count.
Dialogue is broad and conversational rather than a technical glossary.
Generation focuses on instruction following and transformation.
Classification uses one coherent label space.
This is a corrected starter corpus, not a claim of deployment-scale coverage.
